svg.title: New Zealand wine-growing study atlas
svg.desc: Follow a two-island sequence from northeastern Gisborne to inland Central Otago, retaining the true position of each coast. Approximate study locations, not appellation boundaries. Numbers refer to the study key; a shared number connects places in one grouped lesson. 1: Gisborne. Eastern North Island around Poverty Bay. 2: Hawke's Bay. Eastern North Island, south of Gisborne. 3: Martinborough (Wairarapa). Southern North Island east of the Remutaka Range; Martinborough is within Wairarapa. 4: Marlborough. Northeastern South Island around Blenheim and adjoining valleys. 5: Nelson. Northern South Island, west of Marlborough near Tasman Bay. 6: Canterbury / Waipara. Eastern South Island; Waipara is north of Christchurch within the wider Canterbury wine landscape. 7: Central Otago. Inland southern South Island around several basins and valleys.

g.text: Dots locate representative places · boundaries do not represent appellations
